title: World Bank — Bangladesh heat and economic risk
supports: Long-run warming, health burden and national estimates of lost workdays.
limitation: National estimates do not describe each worker or household.

title: IIED — No escaping the heat
supports: Surveyed Dhaka informal-worker households, missed work, income and home heat.
limitation: Surveyed informal workers are not the whole Dhaka workforce.

title: Cornell GLI — Six Seasons, Four Summers
supports: Sampled apparel factories and worker homes, heat season and cooling estimates.
limitation: Findings and payback estimates are study-specific.

title: Dhaka garment worker heat interviews
supports: Worker-reported symptoms and barriers to hydration and cooling in sampled factories.
limitation: Interview experiences are not attributable to a particular fictional worker.

title: UNICEF — Bangladesh schooling disrupted by climate crises
supports: Climate-related schooling disruption, including heatwave closures.
limitation: The national total includes multiple hazards, not heat alone.
